title: #315 Face to Face
prompt: Face-to-face communication is better than other types of communication, such as letters, email, or telephone calls. To what extent do you agree with this statement?

promptSegments.text: Face-to-face communication is better than other types of communication, such as letters, email, or telephone calls.
To what extent do you agree with this statement?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Face-to-face communication allows people to observe facial expressions and body language, which helps in understanding emotions and providing necessary support.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Face-to-face communication allows people to observe facial expressions and body language, which helps in understanding emotions and providing necessary support.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Talking in person fosters a deeper sense of connection, allowing people to share feelings and build strong, lasting relationships.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Talking in person fosters a deeper sense of connection, allowing people to share feelings and build strong, lasting relationships.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Face-to-face communication is better because it allows people to see non-verbal cues and understand emotions.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Face-to-face communication is better because it allows people to see non-verbal cues and understand emotions.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Written or electronic methods are poor alternatives because they lack tone and feeling, leading to misunderstandings.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Written or electronic methods are poor alternatives because they lack tone and feeling, leading to misunderstandings.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point focuses on the emotional and relational benefits of in-person communication, specifically building trust and understanding through non-verbal cues.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point focuses on the emotional and relational benefits of in-person communication, specifically building trust and understanding through non-verbal cues.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point focuses on the practical benefits of face-to-face communication, emphasizing immediate feedback and the ability to resolve misunderstandings quickly.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point focuses on the practical benefits of face-to-face communication, emphasizing immediate feedback and the ability to resolve misunderstandings quickly.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Face-to-face communication allows for a full understanding of the other person because one can observe body language and facial expressions, which helps in building trust.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Face-to-face communication allows for a full understanding of the other person because one can observe body language and facial expressions, which helps in building trust.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Written or spoken calls are inferior to in-person meetings because methods like email can lose the tone of voice and body language, leading to misunderstandings.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Written or spoken calls are inferior to in-person meetings because methods like email can lose the tone of voice and body language, leading to misunderstandings.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
